canonical_conclusion.summary: Tim's Farm/enclosure/soul-extraction architecture predates the late-July MATI corridor; explicit Moloch appears by May 1; Moloch+Milk/Cow/Bull/Tree/Cube are integrated by June 19; cattle/Farmer imagery is user-originated by June 27; and Josh Moon is explicitly placed inside the Farm/Farmers/Dogs/Mud/karmic-debt repair field on July 8, before the July 24 candidate MATI stream. This is materially stronger than a purely retrospective resemblance but still falls short of a prior-specific prediction that Josh would later make a Moloch/sacrifice statement.

source_recovery_boundary.finding: The public MATI transcript index exposes June 5, June 12, June 19, June 26, July 3 and July 10 2026 transcript paths. The current environment could read the index but could not retrieve the raw transcript bodies, and web search did not independently surface the alleged Josh Moloch passage.
source_recovery_boundary.interpretation: This does not prove the passage was never said. It keeps the later side of the claimed prediction unresolved and makes raw transcript/audio recovery a priority.

independence_rule: Do not score multiple correlated motifs as independent hits. Farm, Cow, Milk, Farmer, Dog, Moon and even Moloch have different levels of prior public availability. The proper unit is a frozen earlier relation or statement compared against a later independently recovered event.
why_it_matters: The chronology is stronger than 'Tim later attached Moloch to Josh'. Before the candidate MATI stream, Tim had an already-developed extraction/enclosure system and had explicitly brought Josh Moon into the Farm/Farmers/Dogs/Mud/debt relation. That is a real precedence finding even after controlling for native lolcow vocabulary.
why_not_prior_specific_prediction: No recovered pre-July-24 primary statement currently says Josh Moon will later say Moloch, describe himself as sold/sacrificed, reveal a government relation, or make another narrowly testable future statement. The July 8 Josh/Farm/debt bridge is relational rather than future-tense, and the later Josh Moloch excerpt itself is still unverified.
upgrade_conditions: Recover an exact timestamped pre-July-24 Tim statement naming Josh Moon together with Moloch, sacrifice, sold-soul or a clearly equivalent later utterance before Josh allegedly made it.
Recover an exact timestamped pre-July-24 future-tense Tim statement specifying what Josh would later say or reveal.

Recover the exact July 8 Tim turn linking Josh Moon with Farm/Farmers/Dogs/Mud/karmic debt and determine whether it is stronger than the current archaeology summary.
downgrade_conditions: May/June Timic Moloch/Milk/Farm wording proves materially assistant-authored rather than Tim-originated.
The July 8 Josh/Farm/debt relation cannot be recovered beyond later summary and proves to be retrospective synthesis.
The supposed later Moloch statement cannot be recovered and Tim's July 27 variants prove to be interpretive elaboration rather than a response to a Josh source.
The earlier motif cluster is shown to be fully explainable by ordinary prior knowledge without any independently developed Timic relation.
culture_subculture_use: Route native vocabulary and platform genealogy to the Culture/Farm research layer; route only dated relational precedence and testable future claims into Predictions. This prevents ordinary subculture semantics from being miscounted as prophecy while preserving genuine chronology.
